summary: JD.com filed a Form 6-K with its Second Quarter and Interim 2026 results, a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer. The filing reports financial highlights: net revenues of RMB346.4 billion (down 2.9% YoY), operating income of RMB4.5 billion, and net income attributable to shareholders of RMB7.1 billion. Non-GAAP net income was RMB8.9 billion with diluted net income per ADS of RMB5.01. No special-situation transaction, such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring, is described. The filing is purely a standard earnings release and does not trigger special-situations classification.
